segments.sn22.157:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa uppajjanti saṃyojanābhinivesavinibandhā”ti?
segments.sn22.157:1.3: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā … pe …“rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa uppajjanti saṃyojanābhinivesavinibandhā.
segments.sn22.157:1.5: Vedanāya sati … saññāya sati … saṅkhāresu sati … viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa uppajjanti saṃyojanābhinivesavinibandhā.
segments.sn22.157:1.9: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.157:1.12: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ … pe … api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyyuṃ saṃyojanābhinivesavinibandhā”ti?
segments.sn22.157:1.14: “No hetaṃ, bhante”… pe …“evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.

lines: Dutiye kiṃ abhinivissāti kiṃ abhinivisitvā, paccayaṃ katvāti attho.
Vinibandhā “kāye avītarāgo hotī”tiādinā (dī. ni.3.320; ma. ni.1.186) āgatacetasovinibandhā.
